question: When will FAO publish the 2024 food balance sheet for Viet Nam, and does it change the direct import share of protein (19% to 23% in 2023) or the animal protein share resting on imports (61% to 71%)?
why_it_matters: Extends the protein balance past the 2025 African swine fever wave and the 2024 to 2025 rise in meat and dairy imports; chapter 1 and the key numbers quote 2023.
cheapest_way_to_close: Check the FAOSTAT catalogue (datasets_E.json) for a new FBS DateUpdate and rerun tools/build_tables.py in this folder.

question: Does any Vietnamese agency (NSO, MAE, NIN) compile a national food or protein balance sheet, or the FAO supply-utilisation questionnaire, and can it be published?
why_it_matters: We found none published. FAO estimates for eggs and milk look wrong (DG-174, DG-175); a national balance is the base for RM-01 (publish a national protein balance).
cheapest_way_to_close: One call or email to the NSO agriculture statistics department and the MAE planning department asking who answers the FAO questionnaire.
owner_org_to_ask: National Statistics Office; MAE Department of Planning; FAO Viet Nam

question: What share of the soybeans used for tofu, soy milk and other soy foods in Vietnam is grown domestically, and do the main soy-food makers buy domestic beans?
why_it_matters: Soy foods carry about 181,000 t of protein a year (2023), ten times the benchmark demand path for new routes in 2035; their domestic-input share is the plant-protein security indicator that matters. Domestic output (48 kt) caps it at 9%.
cheapest_way_to_close: Two calls: Vinasoy procurement and one large tofu maker or soy-bean trader; check MAE crop data for soybean use.
owner_org_to_ask: Vinasoy; tofu makers; MAE Department of Crop Production

question: What was the national stunting rate for children under 5 in 2024 and 2025, and is the 14.8% quoted in the press for 2025 an under-5 figure?
why_it_matters: kn-stunting uses 18% (2023). A press report quotes 14.8% for 2025, which matches the 2019 to 2020 survey rate for ages 5 to 19.
cheapest_way_to_close: One email to the National Institute of Nutrition for the nutrition surveillance table for 2024 and 2025.

question: What protein is in the USDA feed-table lines "plant-based meal and bran" (1.83 Mt) and "other protein meals" (0.65 Mt), and how much of the latter is domestic fishmeal?
why_it_matters: Moves the imported share of compound-feed protein by about 2 points (90.4% to 94.4%); context only, it changes no conclusion.
cheapest_way_to_close: One email to USDA FAS Post in Ho Chi Minh City asking for the composition of the two lines.
owner_org_to_ask: USDA FAS Ho Chi Minh City

question: Why does FAOSTAT put maize food use at 1,617 kt (16.1 kg per person) in 2023 when OECD-FAO puts it at 639 kt (6.4 kg)?
why_it_matters: Changes the direct import share of protein supply by about 1 point (to 18% to 22%) and the plant-protein picture.
cheapest_way_to_close: Read the FAOSTAT supply-utilisation account (SCL) for maize in Viet Nam; ask FAO which uses are allocated to food.
